headline: AI-chip rout: CRDO -10.5%, QCOM/ADI -8%, NXPI/KEYS -7.6%, LRCX/MRVL -5-6%, CAT -5.5%. SK Hynix HBM4 slowdown + Broadcom capex miss. CWAN merger-arb closed June 25 at $24.55.

Persisting AI-chip rout (Friday June 26 close, pre-market Monday). LRCX and MRVL escalated to RED on thesis cross-check. CAT improving — tariff revised down to $2.2-2.4B, pre-market bounce. CRDO stabilized. Hyperscaler late-July earnings window primary macro risk.

AEM new RED — Q2 gold crash -14% ($4,861→$4,040/oz) matches thesis key_risk #1 (AMBER→RED). MARA/HUT new AMBER on crypto weakness and Q1 EPS miss. STLD new AMBER on Q2 margin squeeze. LRCX/KEYS downgraded AMBER on recovery. CAT + ADI resolved GREEN. MRVL/CRDO/QCOM persisting RED.

Meta excess-AI-capacity report (CNBC) triggers broad chip selloff: LRCX -9.72%, MRVL -8.5%, TSM -6.94% (new), AMD -6.83% (new), CRDO -4.78% all RED on AI-capex thesis link. HUT -8.35% escalated RED as bitcoin hits 21-month low. CAT -6.71% and TOL -4.39% re-emerge AMBER (unconfirmed by tier-1 source). AEM/QCOM downgraded RED→AMBER as gold/price stabilize. DVN guidance-suspension risk resolved GREEN. CWAN roster issue persists unresolved (3rd run).

AEM new RED — tier-1-confirmed Barnat pit wall movement suspends mining at Canadian Malartic, 60-80koz H2 guidance cut. MARA (-7.47%) and KEYS (-6.50%) escalated AMBER→RED. LRCX -10.19%, MRVL -9.85%, CRDO -6.66%, HUT -8.11% persist RED (HUT now diverging from bitcoin's partial rebound). AMD and TSM price flags cooled to AMBER/resolved; TSM July 16 earnings added to calendar watch. GPC +12.91% on Bloomberg-reported O'Reilly bid for NAPA unit (informational). CWAN roster issue persists unresolved (4th run); NYSE Form 25-NSE delisting effective 2026-07-06.

No new trading session — markets closed for Independence Day (observed Fri 7/3) and the weekend; last session remains 2026-07-02. All flags carried forward unchanged: AEM, LRCX, MRVL, HUT, MARA, KEYS, CRDO persist RED; AMD, QCOM persist AMBER. CWAN roster issue persists unresolved (5th run) and is now time-critical — NYSE delisting effective Monday 2026-07-06 open. No weekend news found that changes any thesis link. Next new data expected Monday pre-market.

Second consecutive no-new-session day (last session still 2026-07-02); all 7 RED (AEM, LRCX, MRVL, HUT, MARA, KEYS, CRDO) and 2 AMBER (AMD, QCOM) carry forward unchanged. FTNT new AMBER — CISA-confirmed 'FortiBleed' credential-exposure campaign (~86,600 FortiGate devices, active ransomware staging), first flagged this run. LMT (unconfirmed ~$3.5B Ultra Maritime bid) and COIN (unconfirmed 'Open USD' stablecoin consortium) added as new informational/GREEN items. CWAN roster issue unresolved for a 6th straight run — this is the final Sentinel read before NYSE delisting takes effect at tomorrow's (2026-07-06) open.

Pre-market read, no new session yet (last real session still 2026-07-02). All 7 RED (AEM, LRCX, MRVL, HUT, MARA, KEYS, CRDO) and 3 AMBER (AMD, QCOM, FTNT) carry forward unchanged. Headline item: CWAN's NYSE Form 25-NSE delisting is now confirmed effective at today's open — roster issue unresolved for a 7th straight run, deadline has passed, portfolios.json still not corrected. FortiBleed reporting escalated to a confirmed link with active INC/Lynx ransomware operations. TSM's July 16 earnings now falls inside the 2-week hyperscaler-capex calendar watch.

First new session since 7/2 (Mon 7/6) brought a broad risk-on rally (weak June jobs report cooled rate-hike fears) that reversed most of the AI-capex-fear selloff. CRDO and AMD resolved to green on fresh analyst upgrades; LRCX, MRVL, HUT, MARA, KEYS downgraded RED->AMBER on stabilization with no new negative catalyst. AEM is the lone RED (Barnat guidance-cut risk unresolved, formal update due 7/29; analysts split Jefferies-buy/UBS-cut). QCOM holds AMBER as Citi's downside catalyst watch (Xiaomi shipment cut) confirms the China-handset-softness risk. CWAN roster issue persists an 8th consecutive run, now fully deregistered (Form 15-12G filed 7/6). LMT's Ultra Maritime bid converted from rumor to a signed $3.45B deal.

Whipsaw reversal one session later: Samsung's Q2 earnings beat estimates but missed sky-high AI-demand expectations, reigniting the AI-capex-durability selloff across the whole chip/AI-infrastructure complex on 7/7. MRVL (-7.42%), CRDO (-7.14%), LRCX (-6.78%) and AMD (-6.57%) all re-escalate to RED — CRDO and AMD had just resolved to green the prior session. AEM remains the lone persisting RED (Barnat guidance update still due 7/29). HUT (-6.83%) and MARA (-6.73%) fell in sympathy with the AI-infra trade even though Bitcoin itself held steady, so held at AMBER rather than RED. TSM, KEYS, HOOD, COIN, CAT and SUPV round out a wide AMBER band on a broadly risk-off tape; NVDA (+0.71%) notably decoupled from the selloff. CWAN roster issue persists a 9th consecutive run.

Whipsaw reversal one session later: MRVL, CRDO, LRCX, AMD all resolved from RED back to green as a broad semiconductor rally reversed 7/7's Samsung-driven AI-capex selloff (NVDA, NXPI, QCOM, ADI, KEYS also up). New RED: SYF -9.64%, the book's worst move, tier-1-confirmed (CNBC) 30-year Treasury yields holding above 5% pressuring consumer-finance names ahead of SYF's 7/21 earnings. AEM remains the lone persisting RED (Barnat guidance update due 7/29). New/upgraded AMBER band: TOL, GPC (O'Reilly's confirmed $10B NAPA bid still undecided), FCX (2nd consecutive ~-3% session), CHD, COIN (crypto-tape softness with ETHA/IBIT also down), SUPV, FTNT. HUT +9.82% (confirmed $7.5B project financing, analyst upgrades) and VLO +6.28% (strong refining margins) led gainers. CWAN roster issue persists a 10th consecutive run. TSM's 7/16 earnings confirmed inside the hyperscaler-capex calendar watch.

STLD new RED (guidance-cut/aluminum write-down, thesis-linked cyclicality risk); AEM persisting RED (Barnat now quantified at 60-80k oz lost 2H2026 production, guidance due 7/29). New macro AMBER: Strait of Hormuz shipping halt amid renewed US-Iran fighting. NTR -3.34% (largest decline, analyst-downgrade drift) and DVN -2.93% (no catalyst) new AMBER; SUPV persisting AMBER (Argentina). SYF downgraded RED->AMBER on partial rebound (+4.87%) ahead of 7/21 earnings. Broad chip rally (LRCX, AMD, MRVL, FTNT) on SK Hynix's oversubscribed Nasdaq debut; FCX reversed to green; MARA +9.91% led gainers on crypto strength. CWAN roster issue persists an 11th consecutive run, still uncorrected in portfolios.json.
